title.narrative: Strengthening Water Capacities, Cooperation and Youth Engagement in Central Africa

description.narrative: This workplan aims to strengthen human and institutional capacities for sustainable water resources management in Central Africa while promoting regional cooperation and youth engagement. Key activities include assessing capacity-building needs in the water sector, strengthening the skills of water professionals and institutions, promoting water diplomacy among policymakers and diplomats, and supporting youth participation in regional and international water initiatives. These actions will contribute to improved water governance, stronger cooperation, enhanced youth leadership, and greater resilience to water and climate-related challenges across the region.
